purpose: Allow a task-specialized weight edit to trade preservation for a measurable public task improvement while retaining the required-set gate.

edit_calculation.eligible_sites: up to five discovered middle MLP write sites selected using public validation

task_gate.comparison: paired exact-match outcomes on the same public validation cases against the unchanged base
task_gate.confidence_interval: paired bootstrap 95% percentile interval over case-level score differences
task_gate.interpretation: Exploratory selection evidence only because the public validation panel is used to choose strength and site; not independent confirmation.

preservation: Report frozen v2 results; do not gate specialist mode on v2 preservation. Do not modify v2 thresholds or evidence.
prohibited_claims: independent confirmation from a validation-selected confidence interval
change_control: No specialist-v2 candidate run until this policy is approved. Future policy changes require a new version and approval.
